sources.author: K. L. Richards
sources.title: Design Engineer's Handbook
sources.qualifiedClaim: Elastic thick-cylinder radial and circumferential stresses have the Lame constant-plus-or-minus-constant-over-r-squared form, with constants fixed by radial-pressure boundary conditions.
sources.repositorySignMapping: Source constant/sign convention is mapped to repository tension-positive stress as sigma_r=A-B/r^2 and sigma_theta=A+B/r^2; internal pressure gives sigma_r(Ri)=-Pi and sigma_r(Ro)=0.
sources.adaptation: Repository uses Ri=50 mm, Ro=100 mm, Pi=10 MPa, Po=0 and derives its exact numerical oracle from the cited equations and boundary conditions.

sources.title: A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy
sources.publication: Finite Elements in Analysis and Design
sources.qualifiedClaim: Published finite-element benchmark family includes a thick-walled cylinder.
sources.adaptation: Different radii/material/formulation; retained only as an independent FE-family cross-reference, not the BM-005 numerical oracle.

sources.qualifiedClaim: semanticHash excludes candidate-head/test evidence; evidenceHash binds semanticHash, candidateHeadSha, qualificationEvidence and diagnostics.

oracleDerivation.planeStressDisplacementDerivation: Combine the cited Lame sigma_r/sigma_theta field with isotropic plane-stress Hooke law epsilon_r=(sigma_r-nu*sigma_theta)/E and epsilon_r=du/dr, yielding u(r)=((1-nu)A*r+(1+nu)B/r)/E with the regular compatible axisymmetric displacement field.
